item.title: Welcome to MaiMi
item.description: What is MaiMi? MaiMi is a gamified learning platform that lives entirely in your browser. There’s no account to create, no server to log into. Your progress is saved right here, in your browser’s local storage. “The secret of getting ahead is getting started.” — Mark Twain How it Works Every lesson is a simple Markdown file. You read through it, scroll to the end, and click Finish Lesson to mark it complete.

item.title: How the Course Map Works
item.description: Your Learning Path The Course Map is the heart of MaiMi. Think of it like a Duolingo tree — a winding path of lesson nodes you work through one by one. Icon style Meaning ⬜ Gray icon Not yet completed 🟡 Gold icon with ✓ Completed How It Updates After you click Finish Lesson on any page: The lesson data is written to localStorage The next time you visit the Course Map, JavaScript reads localStorage and applies the gold style to that node No page rebuild needed.

item.title: Managing Your Progress
item.description: Your Progress Lives in Your Browser MaiMi stores all your data in localStorage under the key user_progress. Here’s what that data looks like: { "intro-welcome": { "lessonId": "intro-welcome", "title": "Welcome to MaiMi", "completed": true, "xp": 10, "completedAt": "2025-01-15T08:30:00.000Z" } } Exporting Your Progress Go to Settings → Export Progress to download a maimi-progress.json file.
